objective: Make the Pi extension (release/0.3.0/feat/pi-extension, head 0ca6337, worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-ext) wait for every child process it started before session_shutdown completes, including those of older aborted gathers, with tests that fail without the fix.
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-ext; gates bunx --no-install mise run verify and bunx --no-install mise run build.

Blocking (review of 0ca6337): (1) session_shutdown is () => release(): it aborts current and returns undefined, so Pi can finish shutdown and a folder can be deleted while sh and git are still exiting (the Windows EBUSY path); (2) gather aborts the older signal but only the newest pending is awaited, so an older gather's children are untracked; (3) the shutdown test awaits the session_start promise, which Pi does not do, so it passes without the fix, and 'when the gather succeeds, nothing is left running' is vacuous. Fix: track every gather started (a set of pendings), make release return a promise for all of them, and return it from the session_shutdown handler; rewrite the shutdown test to await only the session_shutdown emit and to fail on the old code, and make the success test assert something that fails without the fix or remove its claim from the title.

Ride-along (optional review notes): bound the wait on a stopped command with a short grace timeout so a grandchild holding the pipes cannot hang a gather or shutdown; turn a synchronous throw from pi.exec inside Effect.callback into a CommandFailed notice, not a defect; remove the redundant stop controller if interruption already aborts; make the deadline test robust on a slow Windows runner (wider margins or a controllable clock) without weakening it.
constraints: Unit tests and synthesized fixtures only; do not run the pi binary.
Never skip or weaken a test.
Make no version-control writes; report changed paths.
Report in under 300 words; start each evidence line with the exact criterion text (no backticks), a colon, then the support.

The shutdown and older-gather tests fail on 0ca6337 and pass after, and no test claims what it does not check
